label: Coastal Location
description: Shorelines and working waterfronts — harbors, piers, cliffs, coves and dunes.

items.name: fishing-harbor
items.text: A small fishing harbor at low tide, trawlers leaning on the mud beside stone quays, lobster pots and drying nets stacked along the slipway.

items.name: boardwalk-pier
items.text: A wooden pleasure pier striding out over the surf on barnacled piles, painted railings, striped kiosks and a distant pavilion at its end.

items.name: lighthouse-point
items.text: A white lighthouse on a grassy headland above black wave-cut rocks, a keeper's cottage and walled path leading out to the lamp tower.

items.name: sea-cave
items.text: Inside a sea cave, turquoise light bouncing off the water onto wet basalt walls, the bright mouth framing open ocean.

items.name: tide-pools
items.text: A shelf of tide pools on dark volcanic rock, anemones and starfish held in glassy windows of trapped seawater.

items.name: dune-boardwalk
items.text: A weathered plank boardwalk winding through grassy dunes toward the sea, wind-drifted sand feathered across the boards.

items.name: mediterranean-fishing-village
items.text: A Mediterranean fishing village front, colorwashed houses stacked above a curved quay, small wooden boats bobbing on clear green water.

items.name: chalk-cliffs
items.text: White chalk cliffs dropping sheer into slate-blue sea, a footpath snaking through cropped turf along the top of the drop.

items.name: black-sand-beach
items.text: A black volcanic sand beach backed by columnar basalt cliffs, white foam sliding over the dark grains and sea stacks standing offshore in drifting mist.

items.name: riviera-beach-club
items.text: A riviera beach club lido, rows of striped umbrellas and matching loungers raked toward the tideline below a white balustrade promenade.

items.name: storm-harbor-mole
items.text: A stone harbor mole under heavy swell, waves detonating against the seaward face and washing green water across the walkway toward the beacon at its end.
